description: Matplotlib draws charts from data. Learn figures, axes, labels and honest chart choices using small fictional examples that you can explain without advanced maths. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain use a scatter plot for pairs
learningObjectives: Practise place two plots in one figure
Practise save a figure to a file

seo.title: Matplotlib Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Matplotlib with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
